name: Surface Zone
source:
Hero and heroine get to a different dimension - "surface zone". They need to explore the surroundings and find the way out of here.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
男女主人公到达了不同的维度——“表面区域”。他们需要探索周围的环境，找到离开这里的方法。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-april-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
